description: Search slowhop.com, the Polish marketplace of 'slow' stays: houses and cabins in nature, agritourism, guesthouses, glamping, tiny houses and apartments with character, mostly in Poland (some in Czechia, Slovakia, Italy, Croatia…). Filter by place (region, town, country or a landscape word), check-in/check-out dates and party — adults, children's ages, pets (with dates only places free for that party are returned, priced for it) — plus Slowhop's own filters (by a lake, by the sea, in the mountains, sauna, hot tub, breakfast, pets welcome…), a nightly price range and last-/first-minute deals; sort by recommendation or price. Returns one page (24 by default) in Slowhop's order; pass a listing's `slug` to slowhop_place for the description, units, house rules, pets policy and the exact price breakdown. Fetched live from Slowhop's own JSON API (typically well under 1 s via direct fetch; more when it falls back to an unblocker). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, resolved_place: { name, kind, radius_km? } | null, alternatives?, stay: { date_from, date_to, nights } | null, guests: { adults, children_ages, pets }, total_count, page, total_pages, count, listings: [...], note? } — the list key is `listings`; `total_count` counts matches across all pages (use `page` for more). Each listing: { available, restriction, id, slug, name, url, type, type_key, city, region, country, summary, price, price_per_night, price_per_night_before_discount, currency, cheapest_dates, meal_plan, max_guests, units_for_party, rating, reviews_count, instant_booking, only_on_slowhop, for_whom, host, image }. Prices are numbers in the listing's `currency` — PLN for places in Poland, usually EUR abroad — for the WHOLE party, never per person. WITH date_from + date_to: `price_per_night` is Slowhop's nightly price for this party averaged over the stay (it already includes cleaning, pet and children's fees) and `price` = price_per_night × nights, the total for the whole stay (within a few zł of the booking total; slowhop_place with the same dates gives the exact breakdown); `units_for_party` > 1 means it covers several houses/rooms; `url` opens the place with the same stay. Dated, the site also lists places it cannot book exactly as asked — each listing's `available` is true (bookable as asked) or false, with `restriction` { type: min_nights | max_nights | arrival_impossible | departure_impossible | stay_impossible, min_nights, max_nights } saying why; those have price null (price_per_night stays their nightly rate for those dates), come last, and the `note` counts them — never quote an available: false place for the dates asked; slowhop_place with the same dates gives the exact quote before booking. WITHOUT dates `available` is null, `price` is null, `price_per_night` is the lowest upcoming nightly price and `cheapest_dates` says for which stay; availability is not checked (the `note` says so). `price_per_night_before_discount` is set during a last-/first-minute discount. `meal_plan` is none | breakfast | half_board | full_board | all_inclusive; `rating` is 0–5 (null without reviews). An empty match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying why and what to change — that is a successful result, not an error.

children_ages.description: Each child's age in years (0–17), e.g. [4, 9] for two children — prices depend on ages. Default none.

date_from.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Pass together with date_to; without dates prices are the lowest upcoming 'from' prices and availability is not checked.

date_to.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, after date_from (at most 60 nights).

filters.description: Slowhop's own filter ids. Alternatives of one kind match ANY — settings, types, who-for, accepted pets, the wellness facilities sauna/wooden_bath/pool/jacuzzi/bathtube/massages — while different kinds must ALL match (['lake', 'sauna'] = by a lake AND with a sauna; ['sauna', 'jacuzzi'] = either): the site's own logic. Setting: lake, sea, mountain, forest, countryside, shoreline, river, city. Type: agro_guesthouse (agritourism, guesthouse), cottages (houses incl. tiny houses), tiny_house, camping (glamping/camping), hotels, city_apartments, hostels, campers, yachts. Who for: children_loving, couples, without_neighbors, adults (adults and teens only), rarities, unique_view, good_design, modern_architecture, idyllic, historical_places, fixer_upper, pet-free, lots_of_animals, single, disability, celebrations, workshops_and_conferences. Food: breakfast, meals (meals on site), restaurant, kitchen_available, vegetarian, vegan, special_diets. Pets: small_dogs, medium_dogs, big_dogs, cats, fenced_area, leash_free. Wellness: sauna, wooden_bath (outdoor hot tub, 'balia'), pool, jacuzzi, bathtube, massages, fireplace. Active: forest-trails, trail (mountain trail), skiing-slope, running-ski (cross-country skiing), horseriding, kayaks, fishing, bikes_onsite. Other: solo / groups (workation), fast_internet, no_internet, electric-car-charger, kids-playground.

first_minute.description: Only first-minute (early booking) deals. Default false.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

pets.description: The animals coming along, one entry each: 'small_dog', 'medium_dog', 'big_dog', 'cat' (e.g. ['big_dog', 'cat']). Also limits results to places that accept them. Default none.

place.description: Where, resolved by Slowhop's own autocomplete: a region ('Mazury', 'Bieszczady', 'Kaszuby', 'Tatry', 'Roztocze', 'Toskania'), a town ('Zakopane', 'Kazimierz Dolny' — searched within radius_km), a country ('Chorwacja', 'Włochy'), or a landscape word ('góry', 'morze', 'jezioro', 'las', 'wieś' → Poland with that setting filter). Polish names work best. Omit to search everywhere.

price_max.description: Maximum nightly price for the whole party, in PLN (Slowhop converts foreign prices).

price_min.description: Minimum nightly price for the whole party, in PLN (Slowhop converts foreign prices).

radius_km.description: Around a town only: search radius in km (default: the site's own, 20 km for a town).

name: slowhop_search
title: Search Slowhop slow stays (cabins, agritourism, glamping)
